## Key publications

The publication table is @tbl-epic-pubs; the acronym list is @tbl-epic-acronyms
and the recruitment map is @fig-epic-centres. Cohort design is described in
[@riboli1997epic] and the calibration substudy in [@slimani2002calibration].

```{r}
#| label: tbl-epic-pubs
#| tbl-cap: "EPIC pancreatic-cancer publications (and cohort-description papers)."
library(reactable)

# Pipe-delimited so each paper is one line (avoids column misalignment).
# Theme buckets: Cohort description / Biobank / Biomarkers / Diet / Risk factors /
# Metabolomics / Genetics (PanScan) / Genetics (PanScan+PanC4).
pubs <- read.delim(text =
"Year|Authors|Theme|Topic|Data|N|Journal|DOI
1997|Riboli & Kaaks|Cohort description|Rationale & study design|—|519,978 cohort|Int J Epidemiol|10.1093/ije/26.suppl_1.S6
2002|Riboli et al.|Cohort description|Study populations & data collection|—|519,978 cohort|Public Health Nutr|10.1079/PHN2002394
2006|Berrington de González et al.|Risk factors|Anthropometry & physical activity|Questionnaire|324 cases|Cancer Epidemiol Biomarkers Prev|10.1158/1055-9965.epi-05-0800
2022|Porta et al.|Biomarkers|Persistent organic pollutants|Plasma|513 / 1,020|Int J Epidemiol|10.1093/ije/dyab115
2026|Katzke et al.|Biomarkers|92 immune proteins (Olink)|Serum/plasma|406 / 406|Int J Cancer|10.1002/ijc.70581",
  sep = "|", header = TRUE, quote = "", strip.white = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"
)

reactable(
  pubs,
  filterable    = TRUE,
  sortable      = TRUE,
  defaultSorted = list(Year = "asc")
)
```
